full_judgment:
17. In cross-examination, he stated that, he is grand-father of Runa. He denied the suggestion that, Runa did not state anything of the occurrence to him. Runa went to play in his presence at Siphon. Ruad told her let us go and play "ghor shongsher" and enticed her that he would give sweet and took her to haystack field. Runa was taken to beel and after washing the pant, she sat under the banyan. It is not a fact that, he did not state to the investigating officer that Runa was not crying at night. He did not remember the date of occurrence but it was Friday. Korban, Rulu, Ruad, Belal, Rokar, Mannan, Gendar their house is adjacent to his house, they are not witnesses. They had good relation with them. It is not a fact that, since the occurrence being false, they are not witnesses in this case. All these people are on side of the accused. It is not a fact that, Public Prosecutor tutored him to depose. It is not a fact that, he deposed falsely. It is not a fact that, the occurrence did not take place seven months before on Friday. 

 46. It is also in the evidence that the statement under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of the victim Runa was not taken or was not recorded as the victim did not understand anything of the occurrence. In spite of that the same infant how could she state in Court, or to the witnesses that she was raped. When the (অসভ্য কাজ), was allegedly done she was then a student of Class I. From the depositions of the witnesses and other materials on record, we find that FIR was lodged after 21 days of the occurrence without there being any satisfactory explanation for the same, none of the witnesses stated to the investigating officer in the statements under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure about the occurrence and PW 7 who was present all along with victim and the accused, did not state anything of rape or seeing any blood mark on the private part of the victim, also we find that, alamat so seized did not support the prosecution case together with these factual aspects, prosecution withheld the village doctor who attended the victim, PW 2, first. These are the improbabilities of prosecution case. Together with this fact, there was a suggestion that the mark is not of blood but of "kolarmocha". But investigating officer did not send the pant for any chemical examination, led us to hold that, prosecution has failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt. It is a case of acquittal all through but we find that, learned Judge convicted the appellant and also sentenced him to imprisonment for life.
